items.criterion: A developer session calling the approve endpoint is refused by the server and the stored request keeps its state, its claimant and its decider.
items.judgment: Call the approve endpoint with a developer session, then read the request back and compare all three fields.

items.criterion: The member recorded as the filer is refused every decision on that request, whatever role that member holds.
items.judgment: Call claim, approve and deny on the self-filed request with the filer's own session, then read the request back.

items.criterion: A member of another organisation is refused every read and every decision on this organisation's records.
items.judgment: Read and approve a Vantor request with a Wrenwood session and confirm both are refused.

items.criterion: Neither organisation's request queue lists the other organisation's requests.
items.judgment: Read the queue with each session and compare the identifier sets.

items.criterion: An analyst session is refused on every mutating endpoint in the console.
items.judgment: Call four mutating endpoints with an analyst session.

items.criterion: Approving a claimed request stamps the decider and the decision time and moves the matching entitlement to live.
items.judgment: Approve a fresh request and read back both the request and the environment's entitlements.

items.criterion: An approval moves exactly one product entitlement and leaves every other one at the state it held.
items.judgment: Snapshot the production entitlements, approve one product, and compare every other row.

items.criterion: A decide call against a decided request is refused as a conflict and the first decision stands.
items.judgment: Approve a request, then deny it, then read the state back.

items.criterion: A submit missing any of the seven answers is refused and the request stays in draft.
items.judgment: Submit seven requests, each missing one answer key.

items.criterion: The audit chain a caller reads back recomputes from its own stored fields with a gapless sequence.
items.judgment: Read the audit route and recompute each entry hash over the seven joined fields.

items.criterion: A created credential secret appears in the creation response and in no later read or stored row.
items.judgment: Create a credential, then read the credential list and the stored rows for the value.

items.criterion: No console response carries a balance, a transaction, an account number or an identity record.
items.judgment: Read the connection list and two connection details and scan each payload.

items.criterion: Each seeded fixture is stored exactly once however many times the app has started.
items.judgment: Count the seeded applications and access requests in the store.

items.criterion: An environment holds at most two unrevoked credentials and refuses a third.
items.judgment: Revoke the live credentials, create two, then create a third.

items.criterion: The console answers its health route and every seeded identity authenticates through the app's own session route.
items.judgment: Call the health route, then resolve each session against the identity route.
